from email.parser import BytesParser

import importlib.util

def run(req):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("solution", "solution.py")
    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(m)
    import io, contextlib
    old = sys.stdin
    sys.stdin = io.TextIOWrapper(io.BytesIO(json.dumps(req).encode()), encoding="utf-8")
    buf = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
        m.main()
    sys.stdin = old
    return buf.getvalue()

def verify(req, out_text):
    out = json.loads(out_text)
    msg = base64.b64decode(out["message_b64"])
    assert out["sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(msg).hexdigest()
    # 7-bit clean, line lengths
    assert all(b < 128 for b in msg)
    for line in msg.split(b"\r\n"):
        assert len(line) <= 998, len(line)

    m = parser.parse(io.BytesIO(msg))

    assert [str(x) for x in m.get_all("To").split(", ") if x]
    # subject

    subj = m["Subject"]
    assert subj == req["subject"], (subj, req["subject"])
    assert m["Message-ID"] == req["message_id"]
    assert m["Date"].dt.timestamp() == req["date"]
    assert m["MIME-Version"] == "1.0"
